Season found a rough piece of iron deep in a cave, and when he touched it, its quiet strength rang through him ✨

Season is the bright Yang spirit, and when he felt the iron hidden in the stone he became Yang Metal: raw iron and steel. Geng Metal is strong, direct and brave. It doesn't sparkle for show; it gets tougher under pressure and stands up for what is right. In people, it is the side that says what needs to be said, protects the people they care about, keeps their word and gets sharper through every hard day. Real strength is calm.

Who is the one with a heart of iron in your life, the one who always stands up for others? Tag them below 👇
